text:
sam-sales: Quick heads-up — Acme Retail asked for a zero-downtime POC switch between their old embedding endpoint and our inference flow. They want structured JSON output + tool calls and no visible glitch to end users. Can we scope?
maria-se: Nice. They care about failover with 0 dropped requests? any throughput target?
sam-sales: They said 50 rps sustained with occasional 200 rps spikes, median p50 latency <= 200ms, and schema-validated JSON for every response. Also legal flagged data residency + KMS for keys.
josh-ml: For zero-downtime switching we need warm KV caches and session affinity or context forwarding. Two options: 1) Dedicated reserved nodes warmed with the current model, then do traffic switch with canary routing; 2) Use hosted API + edge proxy that fans out to both backends during cutover and dedups.
elaine-solutions: Can confirm: we can do canary routing via rollout policy (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and keep fallback to quantized variant if capacity drops. But warm cache is key. We should pre-warm by replaying a subset of traffic (or synthetic prompts).
kevin-devex: Security note: customer needs SOC2 attestation + SAML SSO and KMS integration. For POC we can provide ephemeral creds and a scoped key for ingestion, but legal may require on-prem/private deployment for any PHI.
maria-se: Pricing question from buyer: will demo require a Dedicated commit? they're worried about sticker shock if we spin reserved capacity for a short POC.
elaine-solutions: We can offer a short-term Dedicated trial (2 weeks) with pro-rated pricing or run hosted with throttled QPS using pre-warmed instances. Pricing ballpark: hosted demo w/ bursts ~ $800–1.5k depending on token volume; short Dedicated trial ~ $4–6k flat for the reserved nodes + transmission. I'll need exact token estimate.
sam-sales: they'll provide sample traffic. Can someone draft a tight runbook and estimate tokens? Also need a short script to rotate ephemeral creds hourly for the demo.
josh-ml: I can estimate tokens once we see avg tokens per request. Example: 5k tokens/min at peak -> ~150k tokens/hr. For structured outputs we sometimes add overhead from function call serialization, factor ~1.2x.
kevin-devex: Ephemeral credential snippet (works for hosted):
```
# exchange session token
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral
{ "scope": "demo:read demo:write", "ttl": 3600 }
# returns temporary key, rotate hourly via cron
```
Use short TTL and rotate before commit. For Dedicated/private we do short-lived certs via customer KMS.
elaine-solutions: Blockers: 1) SOC2 doc pending (we can share compliance pack). 2) On-prem install timeline (they asked for air-gapped box) — that pushes deliverable 3+ weeks. 3) Structured schema acceptance — we need their JSON schema and at least 20 gold examples for eval.
maria-se: Can we do a hybrid? start hosted demo to validate UX + schema, then move to private if security gating passes. That shortens cycle.
sam-sales: Customer asks about tool calling — they want our system to call their internal fraud-check API during generation. How do we demo that without exposing prod creds?
josh-ml: Proxy the tool calls through a demo sandbox we control, or stub the service. Option: provide a webhook with HMAC signed callbacks, or run a mock service in their VPC and tunnel via ephemeral certs. For demo, stubbing is fastest.
kevin-devex: Also note: function/tool call payloads must be validated. We'll include schema guards in the runbook and sample cURL for reviewer. Example cURL for streaming with function call: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-arch-52","stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"fraud_check","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
We should attach this to the POC doc.
elsystem: deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 2025-05-07T15:30:00Z — demo env cluster spin-up (ticket #POC-4567). :robot_face:
maria-se: Next steps: Kevin to share compliance pack link, Elaine to draft runbook & cost estimate, Josh to compute token/latency sims, Sam to lock schedule with customer for the week of May 12.
kevin-devex: I'll upload the SOC2 + k8s-hardening checklist to the shared folder and ping legal. Also adding a quick KMS diagram for private path.
elaine-solutions: I'll put a minimal acceptance criteria section: - schema match 100% on 20 test cases, - p50 latency <= 200ms, - successful tool call stub in 95% of trials, - zero visible errors during canary ramp (<=0.1% error rate).
sam-sales: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker I'll @channel, otherwise I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to align on runbook. :calendar:
maria-se: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
